official_sources.user-inventory-and-official-types: User-supplied Zoho Contracts field inventory and 2026-07-15 tenant UI screenshot, interpreted using the official Zoho field definitions above.
official_sources.user-requested-destination-types-2026-07: User-supplied destination labels and required Currency or Date design types dated 2026-07-24. This is label and design evidence, not Contracts API metadata.
official_sources.user-confirmed-live-crm-api-crosswalk-20: Approved production Zoho CRM metadata-connector readback dated 2026-07-24. This evidence verifies only the CRM API names explicitly marked verified_live_mcp; it does not verify any Zoho Contracts apiName.

labels: Next Total Monthly Rent Due Date

policies.integration_key: Use the tenant-returned Zoho apiName, never a display label or guessed API name.
policies.api_name_verification: Zoho Contracts apiName values remain null until authenticated Contracts metadata is captured. CRM API names may be populated only when explicitly marked verified_live_mcp from the governed 2026-07-24 production metadata readback.
policies.source_of_truth: CRM owns approved pre-authoring party, property, unit, and lease inputs. Zoho Contracts owns contract lifecycle fields and the resolved agreement snapshot. Executed document values are immutable snapshots.
policies.sync_direction: Prefer one-way CRM-to-Contracts authoring. Do not create bidirectional field updates without an explicit conflict policy.
policies.public_repository: Store definitions and validation only. Never store tenant names, addresses, phone numbers, emails, contract values, Zoho record IDs, OAuth tokens, or merged documents.
policies.date_interchange: Use ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD between applications even though Zoho Contracts displays dates as MMM dd, yyyy.
policies.currency: Zoho Contracts custom Currency uses the organization currency. Cross-application records must also carry or enforce the applicable ISO currency code.
policies.uploaded_template_limit: Zoho states that Dropdown, Email, Phone, and Percent document fields cannot be mapped to system fields in uploaded templates.
policies.native_party_field_ownership: Party A fields are supplied by Zoho Contracts Organization Info and Party B fields by the selected counterparty and contact. Do not create CRM Lease mirror fields for native Party A or Party B system fields.
policies.label_only_evidence: User-confirmed live labels establish display-label presence only. They do not verify Contracts apiName values, data types, field IDs, template publication, or deployability.

fields.label: Agreement Name

fields.label: Party A Jurisdiction

fields.label: Party A
fields.validation: Entity/short-name context; keep distinct from Party A Name and never use the display value as a join key.

fields.label: Party A Time Zone Name

fields.label: Party B Time Zone Name

fields.label: Party A Time Zone

fields.label: Party B Time Zone

fields.label: Number of Storage Unit Keys Provided

fields.label: Storage Term Begins

fields.label: Storage Unit Rent

fields.label: Storage Term Ends

fields.validation: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; when present, must not precede the canonical storage start date.

fields.label: Storage Term Starts
fields.validation: Do not create or independently populate. Migrate templates to Storage Term Begins unless a reviewed definition distinguishes access start from billing start.

fields.label: Lease Agreement Effective Date
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease start-date snapshot
fields.validation: Map only from the verified CRM Lease_Start_Date field; retain review-required status until counsel or approved business rules define its relationship to system Agreement Date.

fields.label: Property Apartment Number
fields.validation: Text, not Number; preserve letters, separators, and leading zeros. Prefer the display label Property Unit Number.

fields.label: Base Rent Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease snapshot; Zoho Books owns invoicing and payment truth
fields.validation: Nonnegative, two decimals, and frozen before contract request. This field must not directly create an invoice or establish a paid balance.

fields.label: Security Deposit Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease snapshot; Zoho Books owns deposit accounting truth
fields.validation: Refundable general security-deposit amount; nonnegative and two decimals. Do not treat this contract value as proof of receipt or deposit liability.

fields.label: Total Monthly Pet Rent Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease pet-charge snapshot; Zoho Books owns invoicing truth
fields.validation: Aggregate ordinary-pet monthly rent only; nonnegative and two decimals. Keep distinct from pet deposits, nonrefundable fees, and assistance animals.

fields.label: Base Storage Unit Rent Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease storage-rate snapshot; Zoho Books owns invoicing truth
fields.validation: Per-unit monthly storage rate; nonnegative and two decimals. Keep distinct from the aggregate storage amount.

fields.label: Total Storage Unit Rent Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease storage-charge snapshot; Zoho Books owns invoicing truth
fields.validation: Aggregate monthly storage rent; nonnegative and two decimals. Reconcile assigned units and rates before contract request.

fields.label: Total Monthly Rent Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease recurring-charge snapshot; Zoho Books owns invoicing truth
fields.validation: Total approved recurring monthly rent; nonnegative and two decimals. Reconcile the component equation before automation uses this value.

fields.label: Next Total Monthly Rent Due Date
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease due-date snapshot; Zoho Books owns invoice due dates
fields.validation: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; the first regular monthly-rent due date after the initial amounts. Do not treat it as proof that an invoice exists.

fields.label: Prorated Rent Start Date
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease proration snapshot
fields.validation: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; first date covered by prorated rent. When present, it must not follow Prorated Rent End Date.

fields.label: Prorated Rent End Date
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease proration snapshot
fields.validation: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; last date covered by prorated rent. When present, it must not precede Prorated Rent Start Date.

fields.label: Prorated Base Rent Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease proration snapshot; Zoho Books owns invoicing truth
fields.validation: Base rent for the approved prorated period; nonnegative and two decimals. Use only the governed proration and rounding rule.

fields.label: Pet Security Deposit Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease pet-deposit snapshot; Zoho Books owns deposit accounting truth
fields.validation: Refundable ordinary-pet security deposit, not a nonrefundable pet fee; nonnegative and two decimals.

fields.label: Prorated Pet Rent Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease proration snapshot; Zoho Books owns invoicing truth
fields.validation: Ordinary-pet rent for the approved prorated period; nonnegative and two decimals. Keep separate from deposits and fees.

fields.label: Prorated Storage Unit Rent Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease proration snapshot; Zoho Books owns invoicing truth
fields.validation: Storage rent for the approved prorated period; nonnegative and two decimals. Reconcile assigned units and the governed proration rule.

fields.label: Holding Deposit Amount
fields.source_of_truth: Zoho CRM approved Lease credit snapshot after verification against Zoho Books
fields.validation: Holding-deposit credit applied to initial amounts; nonnegative and two decimals. This snapshot is not proof of payment.

fields.label: Total Due Before Possession
fields.source_of_truth: Approved Lease calculation reconciled against Zoho Books
fields.validation: Do not automate until the full equation, first-full-month amount, fee treatment, holding-deposit credit, proration rounding, and pet or storage charges are reconciled.
